decision: K52 (25 October 2026); Q-08 and K16: licensed recordings
route: hoi4_super_event_audio_researcher (hoi4-super-events skill, sections 12 to 18); the parent wires nothing new: music/zin_super_events.asset already names every file
common: Each moment gets its own licensed recording (no reuse between ids without the owner's approval).

Licence requirement: a licensed recording whose licence and source are documented: title, composer, performer or recording source, source URL, licence (for example CC0, public domain recording, CC BY with the attribution line), licence confidence, duration and usage terms; composition rights and recording rights are checked separately; unclear licences are rejected.

A structured musical recording (chant, hymn, consort, march, orchestral or choral piece), never a drone, stinger, sound effect, synthesised test tone or generated audio; nothing from another mod, game, film or trailer.
Length 60 to 120 seconds (trim and fade the final file; keep the untouched download under docs/assets/super_events/ while work is active).
Final file: Ogg Vorbis, stereo, 44.1 kHz, at music/zin_se_<key>.ogg (the music entry zin_se_<key> in music/zin_super_events.asset already points there, volume 0.8).

Record every track in the canonical audio catalogue of docs/specs/08_art_and_assets/04_music_and_sound.md with its super-event id, and give the parent the recording's title for the song title key zin_se_<key> (the music player shows it while the song plays).
Spoilers: the track title shown in the music player must not name a hidden figure before its reveal (Afrit, the Hidden Council, the being of the black north).
